name: Substack

sources.title: Substack signup page (JS-gated; renders account creation)
Substack Help — 'Publishing is free on Substack'; 10% fee applies only to paid subscriptions
Substack Publisher Agreement — revenue share terms

requirements: A Substack creator account (signup at substack.com/signup)
Publisher Agreement applies if you enable paid subscriptions (10% revenue share + Stripe fees)
preparation: An initial launch post describing the product with your links
Decide free-only vs paid subscriptions (optional — free publishing is full-featured)
workflow: Create a publication: name, subdomain, description, logo
Publish the launch post introducing the product
Verify the publication is live at <name>.substack.com
watchFor: Signup page is fully JS-rendered — automated agents need a JS-capable flow
Substack is a newsletter platform, not a directory: the durable asset is the publication subdomain + posts
Don't enable paid subscriptions just for the listing — that triggers the 10% revenue share and Stripe onboarding
Substack also surfaces publications via recommendations/Notes — some initial engagement helps discovery
countsAsLive: The publication is publicly reachable at <name>.substack.com with the launch post visible to logged-out visitors
unknowns: Whether post outbound links are dofollow
Whether brand-new publications appear in Substack's public browse/search without subscribers
